name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TraceEmitter.gate_replay
title: Physical NAND gate replay with framed output and exact runtime
statement: One gate on the spool appends its exact NAND value to history, emits its true marker and value, advances beyond its registered unary encoding and resets the history head in exactly 5a+3b+2|h|+8 physical ticks. Forward and self references read the default true.
